sections_target.text: Spare parts that may be changed as required:

rows: Undo the discharge and suction line bolts and the pump base bolts.
Lift the pump and place it on wooden blocks.
Check the thrust bearing, inspect it and remove it as required.
Dismantle the pump stages, check them and record the clearance.

Introduction
This document covers the periodic maintenance of condensate pumps. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003, and the electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.
It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda: Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar: General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.
Safety precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority.
Use safety equipment: helmet, shoes and ear muffs.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge and suction valves and the bearing cooling valve.
Tools, instruments and equipment used
Helmet and safety shoes
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper, 8-inch puller and feeler gauge.
Wooden blocks.
Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Remarks | Quantity | Item | No.
Imported | 2 | Thrust bearing | 1
Manufactured in the station workshop | 6 | Spacer sleeve | 2
Imported | 2 | Shaft | 3
Imported |  | Packing 8 8x mm | 4
Manufactured in the station workshop | 4 | Slide bearing | 5
Work steps to be carried out
Open the work order. | 1
Disconnect the pump. | 2
Disconnect the motor terminals. | 3
Disconnect the pump coupling. | 4
Lift the motor. | 5
Undo the discharge and suction line bolts and the pump base bolts. | 6
Lift the pump and place it on wooden blocks. | 7
Check the thrust bearing, inspect it and remove it as required. | 8
Dismantle the pump stages, check them and record the clearance. | 9
Dismantle the pump bearings (4 bearings), check them and record the clearance. | 10
Dismantle the lower shaft connection by undoing the assembly coupling. | 11
Dismantle the upper shaft connection and undo the thrust bearing (2 bearings) and check them. | 12
Reassemble in reverse order. | 13
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of: | 14
- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current |
